description: Combines 60-escalate-bot-cr-not-dismissed (an authorized bot CHANGES_REQUESTED dismissal emitted but overdue past stallTimeoutMinutes) with 31-escalate-fix-thrash (a retryable thread that has already hit fixAttemptsPerThread). handleFixCode checks staleBotCrIds before checkEscalateTriggers (fix-thrash), so bot-cr-not-dismissed wins even though both conditions are independently satisfied.
